list.notes: No load-on-open exists in the current UI — today the Products list only ever gets data during this session via the bulk-upload flow. sortBy is only meaningful for targetQuantity and eligibleIncentive, the only two columns marked sortable in the table config. search matches Category, Sub Category, and Product name.

bulkCreate.notes: Field names and required-ness match the Excel bulk-upload template exactly (Category / Sub Category / Product / Effective Date / Target Quantity / Eligible Incentive are all required columns). Rows are validated entirely client-side before this call is made in the current app.

update.notes: A pencil (edit) icon renders on every row of the list, but has no click handler wired in the current UI code, so it's unknown whether editing opens an inline row, a modal, or a separate page.

delete.notes: A trash-can icon renders on every row with no click handler wired.

history.notes: A history/revert icon renders on every row with no click handler wired; exact semantics (an audit trail vs. a one-click revert-to-previous-value) can't be determined from the UI alone. May reuse the same drawer pattern as the Incentive Activity Log — confirm with the client.
